source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: A study of all individuals with neurofibromatosis in Gothenburg, Sweden found a reduction in fertility of about 20%, which the authors ascribed to social rather than biologic factors.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 113 Samuelsson 1988 PMID 3145256. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.1988 study; attribution to social factors is the original authors' interpretation as reported by the guideline.
independence_flags: secondary citation via guideline PMID 30006586 of ref 113
